name: 胶束水温和卸妆湿巾款
description: 胶束水柔巾温和卸彩，分屏卖点加贴肤微距的冷雾蓝美妆版式

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, mist-blue fields #DCE9F5 and one flat sky-blue split panel #7FAEDC, matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB for routine pairing
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright shadowless beauty softbox key from the front-left with a large fill card, cool high-key exposure, gentle contact shadows only, real skin texture kept
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB and cool white board #F7F7F8, never glossy, never marbled with hard veining
styleLock.typography: editorial serif display headline paired with modern geometric sans-serif labels and hairline rules; in this suite every word is stripped, so type appears only as blank placeholder rails
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline monoline glyphs in #1A1A1A, single stroke weight, crossed-slash variant for exclusion rows, no filled shapes and no lettering
styleLock.presentationRules: the pack keeps the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across packshots; the cloth always lifts from the flap toward the upper right; companion containers stay blank unlabeled props
noDrift: no legible source copy or invented letterforms
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean clinical-beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, soft mist blue #DCE9F5, one flat sky-blue split panel #7FAEDC and charcoal hairlines #1A1A1A, with one product-matched pop accent reserved for markers; cool bright high-key tone; editorial serif display paired with modern geometric sans-serif, all in-image words left as blank placeholder rails; background system of seamless white sweep, mist-blue fields and a matte pale stone ledge #F0EEEB; lighting system of shadowless beauty softbox key from the front-left with a large fill, gentle contact shadows only, real skin texture kept; hairline monoline icon style at a single stroke weight; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible source copy.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用零售堆头形态交代组合装规格
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level on the front facade, framed a hair above so the tops of the packs behind the carton lip read
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a large fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow only
shots.whitespace: none, symmetrical equal margins left and right
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product} presented inside a retail display carton with refill packs standing upright behind the carton lip. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front facade square to the camera at straight-on eye-level, framed just high enough to glimpse the standing packs behind the lip. Bright even high-key studio light with a front-left softbox key and a large fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the carton. Seamless white sweep background #FFFFFF, no scenery and no props. The carton occupies 60-70% of the frame, centered with equal margins and no extra whitespace. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no added headline or body copy, no overlaid lettering, no pack-count numerals, no fake logo, no hands, no gradient or tinted background, no cut-off carton edges, no floating packs without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒交代核心卸彩利益，右侧色块栏留给主张文案
shots.camera: tight 3/4 face crop at eye-level on the left half, flat graphic panel on the right half
shots.lighting: shadowless beauty softbox from the front-left, gentle fill, real pore texture kept
shots.background: flat sky-blue split panel #7FAEDC beside bare skin on the left
shots.whitespace: right 45% kept as a clean empty field reserved for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero split into two matched halves, with {product} implied by the single soft cloth drawn across the cheek. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left half: a generic adult model at a tight 3/4 face angle photographed at eye-level, fingertips pressing one soft cloth pad against the cheekbone, brow cropped by the frame so no full identity reads. Right half: a flat sky-blue panel #7FAEDC carrying two thin charcoal hairline rules #1A1A1A near the top and bottom, left as a completely empty copy block. Shadowless beauty softbox light from the front-left with gentle fill, real pore texture kept and no smoothing. The face-and-cloth panel occupies 50-60% of the frame while the right 45% stays clean empty field reserved for copy. Negative: no readable words or letterforms, no celebrity likeness, no full recognizable face, no beauty-filter skin smoothing, no second product, no patterned background, no watermark.

shots.intent: 让买家代入日常卸妆动作，左侧留白承接机制文案
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level medium portrait cropped from the collarbone, head turned three-quarter
shots.lighting: cool bright studio light from the upper left with soft wraparound fill, natural skin texture
shots.props: plain ribbed cotton tank top worn by the model
shots.whitespace: left 42% kept as a clean empty field for copy, framed by two hairline rules

A generic adult model in a plain ribbed cotton tank, photographed straight-on at eye-level in a medium portrait cropped from the collarbone with the head turned slightly away, one hand drawing a soft cloth along the jaw so only the back of the wrist and fingertips read on camera. Cool bright studio light from the upper left with soft wraparound fill, visible pores kept and no plastic smoothing. shots.intent: 以贴肤微距交代卸除动作与柔和度，右白栏承接主张
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at skin level, near side-profile, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming soft light from the left revealing cloth weave and skin texture, no harsh speculars
shots.background: plain bright panel #FFFFFF on the right half, bare skin on the left half
shots.props: one soft cloth pad held by fingertips
shots.whitespace: right half kept as a clean empty field with one rule line and one short blank footnote rail
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the soft cloth of {product} drawn across the temple and outer eye of a generic adult model, tight zoom on the cloth edge and the skin beneath it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera very low and close, almost side profile at skin level, shallow depth of field with the cloth fibres sharp and the far eye falling soft out of focus. Skimming soft light from the left to open up the weave and fine skin texture, no harsh speculars. The left half is the macro skin-and-cloth field, the right half a plain bright panel #FFFFFF holding one thin charcoal hairline rule #1A1A1A plus one short blank footnote rail, entirely empty. The macro detail fills 55-60% of the frame and the right half stays generous clean negative space. Negative: no full recognizable face, no celebrity likeness, no readable words, no retouched before-after skin, no exaggerated residue, no blurry subject, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用干巾布纹微距证明材质，右列排除清单只留空白证据位
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on the cloth, folds falling diagonally across the left half
shots.lighting: sweeping soft side light from the right, clean and shadowless overall
shots.props: two layered sheets of the dry cloth, hairline monoline glyph marks as graphic elements
shots.whitespace: generous breathing margin around the glyph column, no filled text bars
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the dry cloth sheet pulled from {product}, tight zoom on the fibre surface and its folded edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so two layered folds fall diagonally across the left half, shallow depth of field. Sweeping soft side light from the right to open up the weave, overall clean and shadowless. Right half: a column of hairline monoline crossed-slash glyphs in #1A1A1A on a mist-blue field #DCE9F5, each glyph paired with an empty label bar and separated by thin rules, every bar left blank as an unfilled proof placeholder. The cloth detail fills 55-60% of the frame and the glyph column keeps a generous breathing margin. Negative: no legible ingredient or exclusion wording, no lettered chemistry diagrams, no invented certification marks, no plastic-looking fibre, no extra props, no watermark.

shots.props: one blank unlabeled matte pump vessel, two solid marker discs, one long hairline rule

Straight-on eye-level pair composition: the pack upright and full in the left slot, and in the right slot a blank unlabeled matte pump vessel with no legible label used purely as a routine partner prop. Above each item sits one solid circular marker disc in {accent_color} with no digits or lettering, both discs under a long thin charcoal hairline rule #1A1A1A that spans the width as an empty headline rail. shots.lighting: even high-key studio light from the front-left with a subtle rim on the container shoulders

shots.props: three blank unlabeled companion containers, two empty seal frames, one wide blank banner rail
shots.whitespace: generous empty margin above the lineup and across the whole fascia band below
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen: {product} placed at the front of a small family lineup on a bright shelf, photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the row stands against a soft light fall-off. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Behind the pack, three blank unlabeled care containers with no legible text or logos read only as silhouettes of range. Even high-key studio light from the front-left with a subtle rim on the container shoulders and crisp contact shadows on the shelf lip. Below the shelf, a clean white fascia #FFFFFF carries two empty rounded seal frames and one wide blank banner rail outlined in hairline #1A1A1A, all left unfilled for post-composited credentials. The lineup occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous empty margin above and below. Negative: no invented ranking, award or lab wording, no readable numerals, no real brand marks on the companion containers, no crowded shelf props, no distorted straight lines, no watermark.

shots.whitespace: right third reserved as a clean empty column for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing shot of {product} tilted on a soft vertical wash from mist blue #DCE9F5 down to seamless white #FFFFFF, one cloth lifting away from the flap toward the upper right as if just pulled. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the tilted pack with the cloth caught mid-lift, the pack held in a believable studio-suspended pose with a diffused soft shadow falling beneath it. Bright shadowless beauty light from the front, cool clean exposure. The right third of the frame holds a column of empty hairline label rails in #1A1A1A with no words, left as a blank specification rail. The pack occupies 50-60% of the frame and the right third stays a reserved clean column. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 近白底上堆头盒内并立补充包的正面；图2 半张脸贴巾特写加右侧纯色主张栏；图3 素色背心模特擦下颌加左侧主张栏；图4 眼周巾缘微距加右白栏主张与小字脚注；图5 干巾布纹微距加右列线性划除图标与空标签条；图6 石台双步骤并列（本品包与一只空白泵瓶）；图7 亮架家族瓶罐排列加下方主张栏与长脚注；图8 悬浮抽巾加右侧整段文字栏。品类判定：整套围绕卸除彩妆（源标签语义为卸妆），属着色前清洁步骤而非上色彩妆，亦非单纯护肤保养，故归「美妆彩妆／卸妆」，与库内卸妆膏件同侧；源平台类目字段不作依据。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、包装标签美术、署名艺人名、卸除率百分比与眼部持妆类功效主张、无添加排除清单、成分表文字、专业背书与调研脚注、片数与尺寸等数量事实、平台角标与社会证明；全部图内文字改写为空白栏位、线性占位条与空印章框，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
